# GraphStructuredRetrieval

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A retrieval method that operates directly on graph topologies, using node and edge features to select relevant subgraphs for downstream tasks. Enables topology-aware data access in TCC, where information is inherently graph-structured, improving efficiency and context fidelity.
